reason: My admin already puts the receipts into Excel. Yes, she is always behind, but it costs me nothing extra, and $19 every month is real money for a café my size. Maybe I try the 40 free ones, but I would not pay after.
objection: I already pay someone to do this. Why pay again for a bot when Excel or something free does the same, even if it is slower?
would_change_my_mind: If the free trial showed it caught duplicate or wrong receipts that cost me more than $19 a month, or if it let my admin spend her hours on something else.
